newsitem.title: USA: South Korea recalls diplomat in spy case.
newsitem.headline: South Korea recalls diplomat in spy case.

text.p: South Korea has agreed to recall an embassy official in Washington identified as being involved in a spy operation, the State Department said on Thursday.
"The Korean Foreign Ministry indicates that they are recalling Captain (Dong il-) Baek," deputy spokesman Glyn Davies told reporters.
"Captain Baek has been instructed to return to Seoul by the Korean government," Davies added.
He said the United States considered this to be a cooperative gesture on the part of its "strong ally" South Korea but more is expected.
But he said: "It does not finally resolve this issue. So we look to further discussions with the Korean government on this issue. We want them to cooperate as we go forward in this investigation."

The FBI said on Wednesday that Robert Kim, a computer specialist for a U.S. Navy intelligence agency, had been arrested on espionage charges for passing secret and top-secret documents to Baek, a naval attache at the South Korean embassy in Washington.
